dict.string: NotchOne shows what's playing in Music and Spotify and lets you play, pause and skip from the notch.
NotchOne shows a short alert in the notch when headphones or other Bluetooth devices connect or disconnect.
The Mirror tab shows your camera so you can check yourself before a call. Nothing is recorded.
NotchOne shows a new screenshot in the notch for a few seconds, so you can drag it straight into another app. It only looks at new files.
NotchOne shows a new screenshot in the notch for a few seconds when screenshots are saved here. It only looks at new files.
NotchOne shows a new download in the notch for a few seconds, so you can drag it straight into another app. It only looks at new files.
NotchOne shows a small moon in the notch while a Focus is on.
NotchOne shows the weather where you are. Only your area, rounded to about 1 km, is sent to the weather service.
NotchOne shows the weather where you are. Only your area, rounded to about 1 km, is sent to the weather service.
